steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with the customized app name and target package structure.

steps.title: Define Database Schema and Offline Calculations
steps.description: Create api_schema.json defining the bookings collection, authentication roles, and dynamic tax calculation formula.

steps.title: Establish Build Script
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct SDK, namespace configuration, target environments, and dependency-free rules.

steps.title: Design Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure AndroidManifest.xml with dynamic permissions, entry activities, themes, and services.

steps.title: Create Bilingual Translation Dictionary
steps.description: Implement Lang.java utility managing English & Hindi localized text dictionaries with instant real-time toggling.

steps.title: Develop Native Backend API Client
steps.description: Build BackendApi.java supporting robust user creation, session token management, and structured CRUD endpoints matching JSON rules.

steps.title: Create Splash and Auth Layout
steps.description: Design an elegant Material-inspired login and signup XML layout with high-contrast text fields and custom styling.

steps.title: Implement MainActivity Flow
steps.description: Write login, registration, dynamic language switching, and secure token storage features in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Design Salon Booking Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Create a unified interactive dashboard layout with multi-stage service wizards, date/time pickers, offline pricing, and list views.

steps.title: Write Booking Dashboard Business Logic
steps.description: Develop BookingActivity.java implementing local offline 18% tax calculation, dynamic service catalogs, booking status feeds, and cancellation capabilities.

steps.title: Building Salon Booking
steps.description: Execute final Gradle assembly tasks to package the high-performance Bilingual Saloon Booking native application.
